gates.name: Build and independent verification
gates.exit: A real code change passes tests and produces a verifiable proof artifact (PASS|BLOCKED|NOT_RUN distinguished).

gates.name: First verified sale
gates.exit: Independent buyer pays, receives promised item, transaction reconciled with delivery evidence.
gates.blocker: No external live purchase has closed the evidence chain.

gates.name: MTG master template clone
gates.exit: Clean clone passes acceptance without inheriting private data, credentials, inventory, or payment links.
gates.note: Card-count bands alone are not proof of a valid catalogue or clone-ready silo.

gates.name: Scale what sells
gates.exit: Measured acquisition, conversion, delivery cost, contribution margin, and repeat purchases drive expansion.

lane_economics.rule: Arithmetic illustrations are not inventory or demand proof.

settlement_truth.pending_fee_detail: Must remain pending for fee reconciliation; must not shortcut the full revenue gate.

kill_criteria.verified_revenue_decision: Based only on fully reconciled verified sales.
kill_criteria.data_quality_warnings: Separate from verified-revenue decision; unverified/rejected rows do not zero out a legitimate verified sale.
kill_criteria.fourteen_day_clock: Must be defined explicitly with attempted-lane evidence; absence of attempts is NOT_RUN not PASS.
